Privacy Policy

At Delsi’s Chews, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you visit our website or purchase our products.

By using our website, you agree to the terms outlined in this Privacy Policy.

Information We Collect

When you visit our website or place an order, we may collect the following information:

• Name
• Email address
• Phone number
• Shipping and billing address
• Payment details (processed securely through payment gateways)
• Order history and transaction details
• Device information such as IP address and browser type

Websites commonly collect personal and transaction details such as name, email, phone number, and billing information when users make purchases or interact with services.

How We Use Your Information

The information collected may be used for the following purposes:

• To process and deliver your orders
• To communicate with you about your purchases
• To provide customer support
• To improve our website and services
• To send updates, offers, or promotional information (only if you opt in)
• To detect and prevent fraudulent transactions

We only collect information necessary to operate our services and fulfill business or legal obligations.

Sharing of Information

Delsi’s Chews does not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

However, we may share information with trusted partners only when necessary, such as:

• Payment gateway providers for secure payment processing
• Courier and delivery partners for shipping orders
• Technology providers that help operate our website

These partners are required to protect your information and use it only for the intended purpose.

Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Our website may use cookies to improve user experience.

Cookies help us:

• Understand website traffic and usage
• Remember user preferences
• Improve website performance

You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings if you prefer.

Data Protection and Security

We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure.

Payment transactions are processed through secure payment gateways that comply with industry security standards.

Your Rights

You have the right to:

• Request access to your personal information
• Request correction of inaccurate information
• Request deletion of your personal data (subject to legal obligations)
• Opt out of marketing communications at any time

Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites such as social media platforms or marketplaces. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these external websites.

Children’s Privacy

Our website is intended for users who are 18 years or older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes to This Policy

Delsi’s Chews may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in legal requirements, technology, or business practices. Updates will be posted on this page.

Contact Information

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact us:

Delsi’s Chews
Email: support@delsichews.com
Phone: +91 98405 05114
Address: Neelankarai, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

Shipping Policy

At Delsi’s Chews, we aim to deliver fresh, natural, and high-quality pet treats safely and on time. Please review our shipping policy below to understand how your orders are processed and delivered.

Order Processing

All orders are processed within 1–2 business days after payment confirmation. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays will be processed on the next working day.

Once your order is shipped, you will receive a confirmation with tracking details so you can monitor the delivery status.

Shipping Locations

Delsi’s Chews currently ships across India. We work with trusted courier partners to ensure your pet treats reach you safely and quickly.

Shipping Time

Estimated delivery times depend on your location.

Metro Cities: 2–4 business days
Other Cities and Towns: 3–6 business days
Remote Areas: 5–8 business days

Please note that delivery times may vary due to courier delays, weather conditions, or unforeseen logistical issues.

Shipping Charges

Shipping charges may vary depending on the order value, delivery location, and ongoing promotions.

In many cases, we offer free shipping on eligible orders. Any applicable shipping charges will be displayed during checkout before payment.

Packaging

All Delsi’s Chews products are carefully packed in secure, hygienic packaging to maintain freshness and prevent damage during transit.

We use sealed pouches and protective packaging materials to ensure the product reaches you in perfect condition.

Order Tracking

Once your order is shipped, tracking details will be shared via email or SMS. You can use this information to track your shipment through the courier partner’s website.

Delivery Issues

If your package appears damaged at the time of delivery, please avoid accepting it and contact us immediately.

If your order is marked as delivered but you have not received it, please inform our support team within 48 hours so we can investigate with the courier partner.

Incorrect Address

Please ensure that your shipping address and contact details are correct when placing your order. Delsi’s Chews will not be responsible for delays or delivery failures caused by incorrect or incomplete address details.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about shipping or delivery, please contact us.

Delsi’s Chews
Email: support@delsichews.com
Phone: +91 98405 05144

Return & Refund Policy

At Delsi’s Chews, we are committed to providing high-quality natural treats for your pets. Customer satisfaction and pet safety are our top priorities. If you experience any issues with your order, please review our return and refund policy below.

Eligibility for Returns

Due to the nature of pet food and hygiene regulations, returns are only accepted under the following conditions:

• The product received is damaged, defective, or spoiled.
• You received the wrong product in your order.
• The product packaging was tampered with during delivery.

To be eligible for a return, the request must be made within 48 hours of receiving the order.

Non-Returnable Items

For safety and hygiene reasons, we do not accept returns in the following cases:

• Opened or partially consumed products
• Change of mind after delivery
• Products stored improperly after delivery
• Products returned after the allowed return period

Proof Required for Return

To process a return or refund request, customers must provide:

• Order number
• Clear photos of the product received
• Photos of damaged packaging (if applicable)

These details help us review and resolve your request quickly.

Refund Process

Once your return request is reviewed and approved:

• Refunds will be processed within 5–7 business days.
• Refunds will be issued to the original payment method used during purchase.
• In some cases, we may provide a replacement product instead of a refund.

Delivery Issues

If your order was not delivered or shows delivery issues, please contact our support team within 3 days of the expected delivery date so we can assist you.

Order Cancellation

Orders can be cancelled only before they are shipped. Once an order has been dispatched, cancellation will no longer be possible.

Contact Us

For any return or refund requests, please contact our support team:

Delsi’s Chews
Email: support@delsichews.com
Phone: +91 98405 05114

Our team will review your request and assist you with the next steps.

FAQs

1. What are dehydrated dog treats?

Dehydrated treats are real meat snacks that are gently air-dried to preserve natural nutrients, flavor, and texture. Delsi Chews uses no chemicals, artificial preservatives, or additives.

2. Are these treats suitable for all dog breeds?

Yes. Delsi Chews are suitable for all dog breeds and sizes. Portion size should be adjusted based on your dog’s weight, age, and activity level.

3. How are Delsi Chews different from regular store-bought treats?

Unlike processed treats that contain fillers, artificial flavors, or by-products, Delsi Chews are 100% natural and made from single-ingredient meat sources.

 

4. Are these treats safe for daily use?

Yes. Delsi Chews can be given daily as training rewards, snacks, or chewing treats. Always balance treat intake with your dog’s regular meals.

5. Do dehydrated treats help with dental health?

Yes. Chewing dehydrated meat naturally helps reduce plaque and tartar buildup while promoting healthier gums and stronger jaws.

6. How should I store these treats?

Store Delsi Chews in a cool, dry place. No refrigeration is required. Keep the pack sealed properly to maintain freshness and crunch.

7. Can puppies have these treats?

Yes. Puppies can enjoy Delsi Chews once they start teething, usually around 3 months of age. Softer options like chicken or fish are recommended for young dogs.

8. Are these treats suitable for dogs with sensitive stomachs?

Yes. Because Delsi Chews are single-ingredient and free from artificial additives, they are gentle on digestion and suitable for dogs with sensitive stomachs or food sensitivities.
